applicable_spec_version.note: Compatibility checks observed non-blank coded values only, not schema completeness, provenance, currency or truth on the ground. CKAN date and specification citation do not establish an applicable version.

rank_cross_check_2024.note: Report only, never correct. Read r_method digits independently in width/slope/step order (p22). Survey uses full table 3.3 intervals; trace uses only red-underlined readings (p20-21; figure 3.3 p22). Only observed width code 1 -> C is supported for trace; all other trace width codes and S/A/Z/X width readings are not_checkable because only width C is red-underlined on p21. Slope/step A/B/C use upper thresholds including zero; their Z bounds remain supported. Slope/step S (0 percent / 0cm) is black, not red-underlined on p21, so S and X are not_checkable for trace. Survey S stays supported. Missing/blank/other method digits use the union of supported readings only: width codes 2/3/4/99 retain only their survey reading; slope/step code 1 retains S from survey plus A/B/C from trace. Accepted membership is method_unknown, never plain consistent. Link precedence: not_checkable, inconsistent, method_unknown, consistent. Source link_id lists retain input order, capped at 100 per state/component with truncation and unavailable-ID counts. No source values, applicable-version UNKNOWN, verification or routability are changed.

literal_cooccurrences.note: Literal co-occurrence counts only; missing or duplicate endpoint identifiers have unknown floor. No floor equivalence or connectivity is inferred.

distance_consistency.method: Vincenty inverse; sum of supplied polyline segments
distance_consistency.note: Distance consistency tests axis order and metre consistency under an assumption; it cannot distinguish JGD2011, WGS84 or Tokyo Datum. CSV contains no polyline geometry; these statistics use the acquired GeoJSON links.

representation_comparison.method: Join unique literal IDs; unavailable IDs are excluded and counted per side. Shared numeric fields accept only finite numbers or decimal numeric strings; invalid values are non-comparable. Other scalar fields use exact text; blank/null both absent. Raw attributes are retained unchanged. Node CSV lon/lat compared exactly with GeoJSON Point coordinates. No CSV link geometry is available for a polyline equality check.

older_vintages.note: This endpoint returns latest catalog entries only; earlier vintages were not enumerated.

mesh_coverage.hold: HOLD: nominal mesh membership does not establish actual geometry coverage, feature correspondence or floor alignment.
mesh_coverage.note: JIS X 0410 first/second/third mesh calculation; closed bboxes include cells touched at a boundary. File-name mesh is nominal. Actual geometry may extend outside it. No feature correspondence is inferred.

r1_bbox_containment.note: Conditional on R1 inferred EPSG:6668. Node containment and supplied polyline intersection with the PLATEAU geometry bbox only. No feature correspondence, floor match or route is established.

spatial_overlap.interpretation_limit: BBox overlap only. It does not establish that features coincide, share a floor, or connect; it is not routing evidence.
